Name: Milo's Headcanon Portraits
Author: MiloMorningstar
Description:
My custom portraits, featuring my personal headcanons for the characters

So far only the dateable characters are done, but I will update this in batches and add in more characters!

Main changes aside from just being my style:
Emily and Haley are more alike
Leah has pencils in her hair to set her as more of an artist and also make her more distinct from Robin
Penny has a more 50's housewife look to her
Abigail is slightly more goth
Sam's hair is slightly less crazy
Shane's chicken is cuter :3

All beach and Maru's hospital sprites are done too! I might at some point redo some that I'm not 100% happy with, but I'm posting the mod to get feedback :)

[b]How to install:
[/b]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portaiture[/url]﻿ mod
Put the folder from my zip into the mod's Portraits folder (it should look like mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Milo's Headcanon Portaits)
Talk to someone and press P
Select the right pack
That's it! Happy using!
